method.history_date_caveat: self_paced date is enrollment date; no actual completed_at exists. Replay uses date as documented proxy.
method.target_policy: Explicit career_goal; otherwise proposed next grade; Lead without goal assessed against current grade. Defaults are analysis assumptions, not inferred user consent.
method.candidate_policy: New enrollment, current role/grade, unmet target gains, prerequisites met, future session/self-paced, voluntary, not previously completed except EV_036. In-progress events excluded from new enrollment but should be offered as resume actions.
method.ranking: Candidates sorted for illustration by critical gain, total gap reduction, hours. This is NOT an AI recommender or quality evaluation.
